title: Visualizing the 4d numbers Quaternions
summary: 3Blue1Brown builds visual intuition for quaternions, showing how to think about this four-dimensional number system using stereographic projection and rotations in 3D space. It is part one of a two-part series with an interactive companion site.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the best visual explanation of quaternions and a good way to visualize higher dimensions.

quote.text: He does a great job of explaining quaternions though visual intuition.
